all visible context. Do not invent a numeric similarity judgment or assume that
a higher transfer_likelihood must outweigh a concrete experimental mismatch.

every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited
record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not
independent evidence. Return exactly one valid JSON object and do not reveal
hidden chain-of-thought.

L3 oral exposure records provide supportive context, not direct F measurements: moxifloxacin shows Cmax 4–6 µg/mL and AUC 40–60 µg·h/mL after oral 400 mg; zabofloxacin shows Cmax ~1.9 µg/mL and AUC ~11.1–11.3 µg·h/mL after oral 400 mg; a related fluoroquinolone shows Cmax 7 mg/L and AUC 76.2 mg·h/L after 800 mg.

L4 intestinal absorption and solubility records for fluoroquinolones support adequate absorption: ciprofloxacin showed 71% absorption after oral administration in dogs, high solubility in acidic media (10 mg/mL hydrochloride salt; 3.7 mg/mL FaSSGF for an amorphous salt; complete dissolution at pH 1.2), and >90% in vivo dissolution; gatifloxacin showed 40–60 mg/mL solubility at pH 2–5.
